scripts.dev: npm run contracts:build && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@caqui/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@caqui/web"
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace=@caqui/backend && npm run build --workspace=@caqui/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspace=@caqui/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@caqui/web
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run test --workspace=@caqui/backend && npm run test --workspace=@caqui/web
scripts.avaliar: npm run contracts:build && npm run avaliar --workspace=@caqui/backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
